name: find_places
description: Find real places to visit, eat or do near a city, neighbourhood or point, matched to the traveller's personal style. Places are searched around the city centre (or the given lat/lng); distanceKm is the distance from that centre. Returns placeId, name, category, coordinates, opening hours, links, plus 'tags' (e.g. local pick, well-known, wheelchair, vegetarian, halal, free entry, indoor, family), 'matches' (which of the requested preferences the place meets) and a short description when known. Translate EVERY preference in the request into these parameters, not just the interests: diet, mobility, kids, weather, budget, 'like a local' and things to avoid. Call it separately for different areas or day trips (pass the day-trip town as city). When the traveller names a specific place, put it in 'names' so the real place is in the pool. Only placeIds returned here may be used in a plan.

city.description: Where to search: a city ('Kyoto'), or a neighbourhood or landmark plus city for a specific area ('Gion, Kyoto', 'Nyhavn, Copenhagen', 'near Shinjuku Station, Tokyo'). Use this OR lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude of a search centre, e.g. the chosen hotel, to find places close to it.

categories.description: Kinds of places. Allowed: temple, shrine, church, museum, gallery, attraction, viewpoint, park, garden, zoo, aquarium, theme_park, historic (castles, ruins, monuments), market, shopping, bookshop, restaurant, cafe, bar, nightlife, dessert, street_food, spa, onsen, climbing, hiking, nature, beach, playground. Map loosely: 'art' -> gallery, museum; 'history' -> historic, museum, temple; 'foodie' -> restaurant, street_food, market, dessert; 'nightlife' -> bar, nightlife; 'relaxing' -> spa, onsen, garden, park; 'kids' -> zoo, aquarium, theme_park, playground, park. Include restaurant or cafe on almost every call.

keywords.description: Free-text searches for anything the categories don't cover, as short phrases (max 8): 'bouldering gym', 'cooking class', 'kayaking', 'jazz bar', 'tea ceremony', 'vintage shops', 'night market', 'sunset spot', 'northern lights viewing'. Use the traveller's own words for unusual wishes.

cuisine.description: Cuisine filter for restaurants, as OpenStreetMap cuisine words: japanese, ramen, sushi, korean, thai, italian, indian, seafood, vegan... Several with '|', e.g. 'ramen|udon'.

vibe.description: How well-known the places should be. 'classic' = famous must-sees first (first visit, 'the highlights'); 'hidden_gems' = lesser-known local places first ('off the beaten path', 'like a local', 'not touristy', 'avoid crowds', 'been there before'); 'balanced' (default) = a mix.

dietary.description: Dietary needs, from: vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten_free. Food places tagged with them come first and a wider search for them is added. Set whenever the traveller mentions a diet, religion-based food rule or allergy-like restriction.

accessibility.description: Mobility needs: ['wheelchair'] for wheelchair users, elderly travellers, prams or 'can't walk much'. Removes places marked not accessible and puts accessible ones first.

audience.description: Who is travelling: 'family' (children: kid-friendly places first, no bars or nightlife), 'adults', or 'any' (default).

indoorOnly.description: true for rainy-season, very hot or very cold trips or a 'rainy day' plan: only indoor kinds of places are returned.

freeOnly.description: true for tight budgets or 'free things to do': drops places known to charge entry, free ones first.

avoid.description: Words to exclude, matched against the place's name, category, cuisine and description, e.g. ['casino'], ['seafood'], ['zoo'], ['chain']. Use for stated dislikes, allergies and 'no ...' requests.

radiusKm.description: Search radius in km (default 4) for city sights, up to 15 km. Food uses foodRadiusKm. Outdoor categories and keywords search up to 50 km automatically for day trips.

foodRadiusKm.description: Search radius in km for restaurants, cafes, bars, desserts and street food, 1-15 (default 5).

maxPerCategory.description: Results per category or keyword, 1-40 (default 8). The agent sets this from the trip length: use about 10-12 for short trips and up to 40 for long ones.

names.description: Specific places the traveller mentioned by name (max 6), e.g. ['teamLab Planets', 'Ichiran Shibuya', 'Fushimi Inari']. Each found one comes back first with 'requested' set and is never filtered by the preferences; names not found are listed in 'notFound'. Pass only names (no categories) for a quick lookup, or together with categories.

namesCategory.description: Leave out for places the traveller named. 'cafe' or 'restaurant' looks the names up as ordinary candidates of that category instead: not marked requested and not required in the plan.
